'''Abila''' is a somewhat large town in [[Amadicia]].{{ref/book|8|10}}{{ref/book|c|Abila}}

==Description==
Abila is forty leagues south of [[Bethal]]. It has paved streets and a stone marketplace, but no wall.{{ref/book|c|Abila}}

==Activities==
[[Masema Dagar]] spent some time in Abila and tore down a number of inns and disreputable houses.{{ref/book|c|Abila}}

Acting on information from [[Sebban Balwer]]{{ref/book|8|9}} and [[Queen]] [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]],{{ref/book|8|10}} [[Perrin Aybara]] visited Masema in Abila and convinced him to return with Perrin to meet [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|8|30}}{{ref/book|9|1}}

[[Faile Bashere]] and her companions were captured by the [[Shaido]] in the vicinity of Abila.{{ref/book|8|30}}
